response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with strong low-latency, event-driven, and distributed-systems work (Dlang microservices at Sociomantic, event-driven GIS platform), plus solid testing and mentoring credentials. However, the role's core requirement — deep, current C++/STL expertise — is barely represented: roughly six months of C/C++ component work at National Instruments in 2015 and a university thesis project, with C++ absent from his listed skills. He also lacks the industrial automation domain background, IEC 62443/SDL security experience, MQTT/Modbus/OPC UA protocol exposure, and Azure cloud services the position emphasizes. His profile is predominantly web/full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React), which does not align with an on-premises industrial C++ platform role.
strengths: Strong distributed, event-driven, low-latency systems experience
Broad seniority with mentoring, workshops, and TDD/CI advocacy
Full-stack familiarity incl. React/Node.js (listed as advantageous)
concerns: Minimal and dated hands-on C++/STL experience
No industrial automation, IoT protocol, or IEC 62443/SDL exposure
No Azure, MQTT, or industrial cybersecurity background

key_factors.factor: Industrial automation & IEC 62443 security domain gap
